comment: App Store Connect の課金商品定義 (issue #48。価格は仮で design_handoff_igen/README.md「ペイウォール」に従う)。~/.claude/skills/appstore-in-app-purchase の iap_apply_config.sh --config <このファイル> (consumable) と iap_apply_subscriptions.sh --config <このファイル> (サブスク) で冪等に適用する。productId は ios/Igen/Utils/Purchases/PurchasesSetup.swift・backend/functions/src/entitlement.ts・fastlane/in_app_purchases/revenuecat.config.json・ios/IgenTests/Igen.storekit と揃える

iaps.reviewNote: Consumable ticket that adds one reply letter beyond the free daily limit (1 letter per day). Open the paywall from the home screen link and tap the ticket button to purchase.

locales.name: 相談チケット「ひとしずく」
locales.description: 今夜だけ、もう一通。返書を1通追加でお届けします

locales.name: Letter Ticket "Hitoshizuku"
locales.description: One more letter tonight. Adds one reply letter.

subscriptions.reviewNote: Auto-renewable monthly plan that removes the free daily limit (1 letter per day). Open the paywall from the home screen link and tap the plan button to purchase.

locales.name: 聞き放題「星読み」(月額)
locales.description: 返書が無制限に。1日1通の枠を気にせず話せます

locales.name: Hoshiyomi Unlimited (Monthly)
locales.description: Unlimited letters with no daily limit, billed monthly

subscriptions.reviewNote: Auto-renewable annual plan that removes the free daily limit (1 letter per day). Same benefits as the monthly plan, billed yearly.

locales.name: 聞き放題「星読み」(年額)
locales.description: 返書が無制限に。年払いでお得に使えます

locales.name: Hoshiyomi Unlimited (Annual)
locales.description: Unlimited letters with no daily limit, billed yearly
